text: Professional Overview: This major belongs to the category of engineering management. It focuses on the logistics system as the research object, and studies the planning and design of the logistics system, the planning and control of the logistics operation process, the optimization allocation of resource flows such as material flow, information flow and capital flow, as well as the strategies for supply chain cooperation and coordination from both domestic and international perspectives.Training Objectives: To cultivate application-oriented and multi-disciplinary logistics management professionals with comprehensive engineering capabilities in logistics systems, including prediction and planning of logistics systems, logistics system design, logistics information technology, transportation engineering, logistics facility planning, etc.Main Courses: Usually include Logistics Overview, Supply Chain Management, Logistics System Planning and Design, Logistics Information Technology, Warehousing and Distribution Management, Transportation Management, Logistics Cost Management, Logistics Facilities and Equipment, Operations Research, Management Information System, etc.Research Directions: Common ones include logistics planning and design, logistics supply chain management, intelligent logistics, etc. Some schools also offer directions such as logistics process management technology and international trade logistics.
